nodes.label: Unknown Metadata Convention
nodes.rationale: Unknown or unmeasured metadata remains null rather than zero, false, or empty text. Use SI units, explicit frames, actual component IDs, and measurement/config/operator provenance. The form is metadata rather than runtime configuration. Only a JSON object and nonempty session_id are enforced; the full field conventions are not an implemented JSON Schema.

nodes.label: Flashed Firmware Identity
nodes.rationale: Record reviewed source separately from flashed commit/binary hash evidence, board revision, USB identity, Agent environment/domain, motor compatibility, and boot/RC verification. A laptop checkout or USB descriptor does not establish the board binary. Fields remain null until evidenced, and an IMU profile does not establish motor/navigation function.

nodes.label: Geometry Load Measurements
nodes.rationale: Measure actual wheel radius, loaded effective radius, contact-center track, footprint, clearance, total/payload mass, and caster geometry with methods and per-measurement uncertainty. Effective radius inferred from displacement and rotation assumes sufficiently little slip. CAD, TF, caster observations, and COM estimates retain their distinct evidence labels.

nodes.label: Signal Classification
nodes.rationale: Separate requested command, limited/executed reference, encoder feedback, and independent body motion. Channels are command, estimate, measured, or reported_unverified. /cmd_vel does not supply executed wheel targets; effort is not automatically measured torque. PI rate, publication rate, hardware sampling, source stamps, and receipt clocks have different meanings.

nodes.label: Versioned Session Annotation
nodes.rationale: Actual session conditions, failures, interventions, outcomes, and split assignments require evidence. Preserve hashed original metadata and add a separate version such as session.annotated.json for post-run findings. Do not rewrite conditions retrospectively or relabel previously inspected/tuned data as an unseen held-out test.
